logger.doc:name: Evaluation started
logger.message: #[%dw 2.0 output application/json import buildLog from dwl::log var message ={ userId: vars.userId, date: vars.date, mealsLogged: vars.mealStatus.mealsLogged, nutritionResolved: vars.mealStatus.nutritionResolved, dailyDataAvailable: vars.wearableStatus.dailyDataAvailable, baselineAvailable: vars.wearableStatus.baselineAvailable, caloricTarget: vars.userProfile.profile.dailyCaloricTarget, mode: vars.textMode } --- buildLog("INFO","Evaluation started",message,vars.correlationId, "evaluate-daily-insight-subflow")]

logger.doc:name: Nutrition aggregated
logger.message: #[%dw 2.0 output application/json import buildLog from dwl::log var message ={ userId: vars.userId, totalCalories: vars.nutritionAggregate.dailyTotals.energyKcal } --- buildLog("INFO","Nutrition aggregated",message,vars.correlationId, "evaluate-daily-insight-subflow")]

logger.doc:name: Calories and macros evaluated
logger.message: #[%dw 2.0 output application/json import buildLog from dwl::log var message ={ userId: vars.userId, caloriesStatus: vars.nutritionDetail.calories.status, macrosStatus: vars.nutritionDetail.macros.status } --- buildLog("INFO","Calories and macros evaluated",message,vars.correlationId, "evaluate-daily-insight-subflow")]

logger.doc:name: Micronutrients evaluated
logger.message: #[%dw 2.0 output application/json import buildLog from dwl::log var message ={ userId: vars.userId, surfacedCount: sizeOf(vars.microsDetail) } --- buildLog("INFO","Micronutrients evaluated",message,vars.correlationId, "evaluate-daily-insight-subflow")]

logger.doc:name: Sleep activity recovery evaluated
logger.message: #[%dw 2.0 output application/json import buildLog from dwl::log var message ={ userId: vars.userId, sleepStatus: vars.biometricDetail.sleep.status, recoveryStatus: vars.biometricDetail.recovery.status } --- buildLog("INFO","Sleep/activity/recovery evaluated",message,vars.correlationId, "evaluate-daily-insight-subflow")]

logger.doc:name: LLM Generation Failed
logger.message: #[%dw 2.0 output application/json import buildLog from dwl::log var message ={ userId: vars.userId, error: error.errorType, description: error.description } --- buildLog("INFO","LLM generation failed, falling back to template",message,vars.correlationId, "create-llm-based-text")]

logger.doc:name: Custom Model Generation Failed
logger.message: #[%dw 2.0 output application/json import buildLog from dwl::log var message ={ userId: vars.userId, error: error.errorType, description: error.description } --- buildLog("INFO","Custom Model Generation Failed, falling back to template",message,vars.correlationId, "create-llm-based-text")]

logger.doc:name: Insight conclusions complete
logger.message: #[%dw 2.0 output application/json import buildLog from dwl::log var message ={ userId: vars.userId, recommendationCount: sizeOf(vars.insightConclusions.recommendations), crossSignalCount: sizeOf(vars.insightConclusions.cross_signal), mode: vars.textMode } --- buildLog("INFO","Insight conclusions complete",message,vars.correlationId, "evaluate-daily-insight-subflow")]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/java import * from dwl::computes::dailyInsightResponse --- { user_id: vars.userId, date: vars.date, generated_at: now(), generation_mode: vars.textMode, data_completeness: buildDataCompleteness(vars.mealStatus,vars.wearableStatus), dimension_status: buildDimensionStatus(vars.nutritionDetail, vars.biometricDetail,vars.microsDetail), nutrition_detail: buildNutritionDetail(vars.nutritionDetail,vars.microsDetail), biometric_detail: buildBiometricDetail(vars.biometricDetail.sleep,vars.biometricDetail.activity,vars.biometricDetail.recovery), recommendations: vars.insightConclusions.recommendations, cross_signal: vars.insightConclusions.cross_signal, metrics_shown : (vars.userProfile.preferences.preferredWearableMetrics default []) ++ (vars.userProfile.preferences.preferredNutritionMetrics default []) }

logger.doc:name: Template Text Attached
logger.message:
#[%dw 2.0 output application/json import buildLog from dwl::log var message ={ userId: vars.userId,
} --- buildLog("INFO","Template Text Attached",message,vars.correlationId, "create-llm-based-text")]

logger.doc:name: LLM Request Complete
logger.message: #[%dw 2.0 output application/json import buildLog from dwl::log var message ={ userId: vars.userId, payload: payload } --- buildLog("INFO","LLM Request Complete",message,vars.correlationId, "create-llm-based-text")]

ee:variables.ee:set-variable:
%dw 2.0 output application/java
import attachLlmText from dwl::template::parseLLMText --- attachLlmText(vars.insightConclusions.recommendations,vars.insightConclusions.cross_signal,payload.data)

logger.doc:name: LLM Text Attached
logger.message:
#[%dw 2.0 output application/json import buildLog from dwl::log var message ={ userId: vars.userId,
} --- buildLog("INFO","LLM Text Attached",message,vars.correlationId, "create-llm-based-text")]
